correctness.rationale: For XY!=0, z,Xz,Yz,XYz form a basis, giving the single regular E-module orbit of dimension16-4=12. The annihilating locus is the proper image of a rank-eight vector bundle over Gr(2,4), irreducible dimension12. In the rank2 X chart Y=(A,B;0,-A), A²=0 and [A,B]=0; nonzero nilpotent A has centralizer kI+kA, so its closure intersects A=0 precisely when B has repeated eigenvalues, with reduced char2 equation tr B=0. Thus intersection has dimension11. Counting rank0/rank1/rank2 square-zero X and corresponding Y fibers yields q^6(2q^6+q^5+q^4-q²-q-1), with nonzero-product regular orbit |GL4|/(q³(q-1)). Independently checked q=2 counts 10816 total and 2520 nonzero and algebraic polynomial identity. Computations only illustrate all-field geometric proof.
